message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Address | Pet Policy | Contact | |---------|---------|------------|---------| | **Miami Central Station (Tri‑Rail)** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | • Small pets (dogs, cats, etc.) are allowed on Tri‑Rail trains **only if they are in a carrier** that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• Pets must be leashed or in a carrier while on the platform and in the station.
• No pets are allowed on the platform during boarding if the train is full.
• The station itself is fully accessible and has no restrictions on bringing pets into the building, so you can walk your dog around the station before boarding. | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: [Tri‑Rail](https://www.tri-rail.com/) | ### Why this station is pet‑friendly - **Tri‑Rail’s pet policy** is the most permissive in the region; it explicitly allows small pets in carriers on all trains, making it easy to travel with a furry friend. - The station is a modern intermodal hub with ample space, elevators, and clear signage, so you can comfortably navigate with a pet. - It’s located in downtown Miami, close to many pet‑friendly cafés, parks, and the beach, so you can plan a quick stop before or after your ride. ### Quick Tips for Traveling with Your Pet 1. **Check the carrier size**: The carrier must fit under the seat or in the luggage area. Tri‑Rail provides a size chart on its website. 2. **Leash or carrier**: Keep your pet leashed or in a carrier while on the platform and in the station. 3. **Plan ahead**: Arrive early to give yourself time to find a suitable spot and avoid crowds. 4. **Stay hydrated**: Bring a small water bowl and a few treats for your pet. If you’re looking for a different train service (e.g., Amtrak), note that there is no Amtrak station in Miami; the nearest Amtrak stop is in West Palm Beach, which also allows pets in carriers on its trains. Enjoy your trip—your pet will be just as happy as you!
